€375. That's the official fee for a deed and its registration at a Casa Pronta office in Portugal.

For clients who live abroad, the fee is rarely the obstacle. The signature is. In Google's autocomplete for Portuguese speakers in Luxembourg, France and Switzerland, "escritura casa" (the house deed) is among the top ten searches about buying in Portugal.

The official sources say no flight is needed. A power of attorney signed at a Portuguese consulate, or before a local notary with the Hague Apostille, lets a representative sign the promissory contract and the deed.

What the official pages say about the closing itself:
· Casa Pronta does the deed and the land registration in one sitting: €375, €700 with a mortgage, €50 per extra property.
· It asks for the ID and tax numbers of both parties, the usage license or its waiver, and the energy certificate.
· Lawyer and notary fees are separate.

For banks, advisers and developers with clients abroad, the signature sets the calendar.

Sources: Justiça.gov.pt, Balcão Casa Pronta; Consulates General of Portugal, power of attorney

93 659 Portugais vivaient au Luxembourg au recensement de 2021, soit 14,5 % de la population (STATEC).

Pour les banques, les conseillers et les fiduciaires du Grand-Duché, un achat au Portugal pose vite une question pratique : faut-il prendre l'avion pour signer ?

La réponse des sources officielles est non. La procuration se signe :
· dans un consulat du Portugal, sans autre formalité ;
· ou devant un notaire luxembourgeois, avec l'apostille de La Haye.

Ensuite, l'acte et l'enregistrement se font en une seule fois au guichet Casa Pronta : 375 €, ou 700 € avec une hypothèque.

Le Luxembourg étant dans l'UE, le représentant fiscal au Portugal reste facultatif après l'achat (Lei Geral Tributária, art. 19).

Sources : STATEC ; consulats du Portugal ; Justiça.gov.pt, Casa Pronta ; Lei Geral Tributária, art. 19

Proof of funds is part of the closing calendar in Portugal.

Under Lei 83/2017, banks, notaries and lawyers are obliged entities: they must obtain information on the origin of funds when the risk profile or the operation calls for it. Businesses carrying out real-estate activities must identify their clients, with photo ID, before the deal.

For a client who signs from abroad by power of attorney, the check still happens. The documents travel; the client doesn't.

What this means for the professionals around a cross-border purchase:
· the bank sending the money and the lawyer holding the power of attorney can both ask for the origin of the funds;
· a file that is ready before the promissory contract keeps the deed date;
· the transfer tax (IMT) is due on the day it's assessed or within the next 30 days, so the money has to be in place early.

Wealth managers and transfer providers who prepare that file are part of the closing.

Sources and the full guide are in the first comment.

Sources: Lei 83/2017; Decree-Law 97/2026 (IMT Code, art. 36)

$10,000. When a US person's foreign accounts add up to more than that at any time in the year, an FBAR is due (IRS).

It matters for anyone helping an American client buy in Portugal from home. A Portuguese bank account opened to pay the deposit counts toward that threshold.

What the official sources say about closing from the US:
· The power of attorney is signed before a US notary with the Hague Apostille, or at a Portuguese consulate, such as the one in Newark.
· Deed and registration at Casa Pronta cost €375, about $420 at the ECB rate of October 23, 2026.
· Living outside the EU, the owner appoints a tax representative in Portugal or joins the electronic notifications within 15 days of owning the home.

For US advisers, CPAs and wealth managers, the Portuguese closing and the US filing calendar run on the same dates.

The full guide and its sources are in the first comment.

Sources: IRS; Consulate General of Portugal in Newark; Justiça.gov.pt, Casa Pronta; ECB, Oct 23, 2026; Portuguese Tax Authority

10 853 CHF : le prix médian du m² d'un appartement en PPE dans le canton de Genève en 2024 (OCSTAT). Au taux BCE du 23 octobre 2026, 11 762 €.

Au Portugal, ce montant achète 2,3 m² à Lisbonne, 2,4 à Cascais, 2,8 à Loulé et 3,2 à Porto, au prix médian de l'INE du 2e trimestre 2026.

Pour les gérants de fortune et les conseillers en Suisse romande, deux règles comptent :
· le 2e pilier ne finance que la résidence principale, en Suisse ou à l'étranger, pas une résidence secondaire (OFAS) ;
· la Suisse est hors UE et EEE : après l'achat, un représentant fiscal au Portugal ou l'adhésion aux notifications électroniques est obligatoire.

La signature se fait à distance : procuration au consulat du Portugal, ou chez un notaire genevois avec l'apostille de La Haye.

Méthode : canton et non ville, 2024 face à 2026, médianes des deux côtés.

Notre guide est dans le premier commentaire.

Sources : OCSTAT ; INE ; BCE ; OFAS ; Lei Geral Tributária, art. 19
